headline: Archipelago remembers save-slot rooms and Difficulty preserves Blarg Station's landing
summary: Archipelago now remembers the room associated with each memory-card save slot and refuses saves from another seed. Its logic and reconnect handling also received fixes. Difficulty reserves room for Blarg Station's own objects, addressing a landing that could lose the ship and Clank when extra enemies filled the object pool.
highlights: #24 corrects Archipelago logic and client handling; #26 adds save-slot room checks using SDK 1.11.
#34 leaves Blarg Station's object pool available for its own spawns.
#27 rebuilds the mod index after releases; #30 and #32 improve listing validation and error messages.
#33 records AI assistance per mod listing; #21 alerts maintainers when index publication fails and recovers.
